layers.name: CPU execution
layers.capability: AArch64 interpreter, cached/decoded/fused block paths (Tier 1–3), optional Tier-4 native JIT and AArch64-host native execution
layers.boundary: Instruction coverage is partial; Tier-4 and native execution are separate from the Interpreter/Tier-3 headline oracle count.

layers.name: Memory and kernel
layers.capability: 4 KiB paged guest memory, access permissions, thread scheduling, synchronization and selected SVCs
layers.boundary: Horizon-style subsets, not complete OS semantics, hardware timing or a security sandbox.

layers.name: Services and loading
layers.capability: Selected CMIF/TIPC service models; NRO/NSO and package parsing; homebrew and synthetic execution paths
layers.boundary: Incomplete service coverage; only unencrypted homebrew formats are loaded; parsing a file does not demonstrate execution.

layers.name: Graphics and presentation
layers.capability: Guest-frame capture, software rasterization, and experimental guest SASS execution through wgpu with render-target readback
layers.boundary: Physical GPU execution and unchanged outside-frame oracles have separate qualification gates.

layers.name: Audio and input
layers.capability: Software audio mixing with CPAL host output; keyboard/gamepad mapping and selected HID service paths
layers.boundary: Host device support varies by platform; external-program correctness needs case-specific tests.

layers.name: Execution evidence
layers.capability: Ounce-Verify records, first-frame oracles, artifact-integrity checks, corpus comparison, diagnosis, retries, bisection and resumable runs
layers.boundary: Passing local unit tests or CI does not certify general compatibility, provenance or an independent rerun.
